parent.required_parent_fact: C070-C score-state-duration structural signal reproduced; C070-D alpha=1 end-to-end integration negative

fresh_split.boundary_algorithm: group A04 matches by UTC calendar date; choose the end-of-date cumulative count minimizing abs(cumulative_count-200); tie -> earlier boundary date
fresh_split.calibration_partition: all A04 matches on or before frozen split boundary date
fresh_split.confirmation_partition: all A04 matches after frozen split boundary date

estimand.target: conditional Draw versus one-goal win at 90 minutes
matching_objective: among maximum-cardinality solutions minimize total squared caliper-normalized distance

pit_asof.a04_calibration_predictions: prequential; only prior UTC dates may update model/team state
pit_asof.alpha_freeze_point: after all calibration predictions and labels are complete, before any confirmation label is used for alpha or hyperparameter selection
pit_asof.a04_confirmation_predictions: prequential strict OOS; alpha and all research hyperparameters remain frozen; prior completed confirmation dates may enter ordinary model/state updates but may not alter alpha, feature definitions, gates, or hyperparameters

duration_mechanism.definition: C070-C fixed Semi-Markov versus Markov score-state generator residual

integration.alpha_objective: minimize binary Log Loss on A04 calibration matched pairs

confirmation_metrics.primary: candidate minus incumbent binary Log Loss
confirmation_metrics.chronological_stability: sort confirmation pairs by max kickoff UTC of the two matches; split into first and second halves by pair count

all_required: confirmation pair-bootstrap 90% CI upper bound for delta Log Loss < 0
confirmation chronological first-half delta Log Loss <= 0
confirmation chronological second-half delta Log Loss <= 0

boundaries.if_fail: close current duration-to-probability mapping route; any further work requires a new preregistered information/data family, not retuning this confirmation
